def option_missing(opt: str) -> int:
    return tcc_error(f"argument to '{opt}' is missing")


def take_arg(args: List[str], i: int, opt: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], int, Optional[int]]:
    if i + 1 >= len(args):
        return None, i, option_missing(opt)
    return args[i + 1], i + 1, None


def parse_wl_option(opt: str, options: Options) -> Optional[int]:
    # opt is the part after -Wl,
    if opt == "":
        return None
    pieces = opt.split(",")
    j = 0
    while j < len(pieces):
        p = pieces[j]
        if p == "":
            j += 1
            continue
        if p in ("-nostdlib",):
            options.nostdlib = True
        elif p in ("-whole-archive", "--whole-archive", "-no-whole-archive", "--no-whole-archive",
                   "-export-all-symbols", "-export-dynamic", "--export-dynamic",
                   "-enable-new-dtags", "--enable-new-dtags", "-Bsymbolic", "--Bsymbolic"):
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl," + p)
            if p in ("-export-all-symbols", "-export-dynamic", "--export-dynamic"):
                options.rdynamic = True
        elif p in ("-soname", "--soname"):
            if j + 1 >= len(pieces) or not pieces[j + 1]:
                return option_missing("-Wl,-soname")
            options.soname = pieces[j + 1]
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl,-soname," + pieces[j + 1])
            j += 1
        elif p.startswith("-soname=") or p.startswith("--soname="):
            val = p.split("=", 1)[1]
            options.soname = val
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl,-soname," + val)
        elif p.startswith("-rpath=") or p.startswith("--rpath="):
            val = p.split("=", 1)[1]
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl,-rpath," + val)
        elif p in ("-rpath", "--rpath"):
            if j + 1 >= len(pieces) or not pieces[j + 1]:
                return option_missing("-Wl,-rpath")
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl,-rpath," + pieces[j + 1])
            j += 1
        elif p.startswith("-dynamic-linker=") or p.startswith("--dynamic-linker="):
            val = p.split("=", 1)[1]
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl,--dynamic-linker," + val)
        elif p in ("-dynamic-linker", "--dynamic-linker"):
            if j + 1 >= len(pieces) or not pieces[j + 1]:
                return option_missing("-Wl,-dynamic-linker")
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl,--dynamic-linker," + pieces[j + 1])
            j += 1
        elif p.startswith("-I") and len(p) > 2:
            # TCC's -Wl,-Ipath sets the ELF interpreter.
            options.linker_opts.append("-Wl,--dynamic-linker," + p[2:])
        elif (p.startswith("-image-base=") or p.startswith("--image-base=") or
              p.startswith("-Ttext=") or p.startswith("--Ttext=") or
              p.startswith("-section-alignment=") or p.startswith("--section-alignment=") or
              p.startswith("-oformat=") or p.startswith("--oformat=") or
              p.startswith("-init=") or p.startswith("-fini=") or p.startswith("-Map=") or
              p in ("-as-needed", "--as-needed", "-O") or p.startswith("-z=")):
            # Some are supported by TCC, some ignored.  Passing most of them through is harmless;
            # explicitly ignored ones are omitted.
            if not (p.startswith("-init=") or p.startswith("-fini=") or p.startswith("-Map=") or
                    p in ("-as-needed", "--as-needed", "-O") or p.startswith("-z=")):
                options.linker_opts.append("-Wl," + p)
        else:
            return tcc_error(f"unsupported linker option '{p}'")
        j += 1
    return None


def parse_args(args: List[str]) -> Tuple[Optional[Options], int]:
    options = Options(raw_args=args)
    if not args:
        options.show_help_due_noargs = True
        return options, 0

    i = 0
    stop_options = False
    while i < len(args):
        arg = args[i]

        if options.ar_mode:
            options.ar_args.append(arg)
            i += 1
            continue

        if options.run_mode and options.run_file is not None:
            options.run_args.extend(args[i:])
            break

        if options.run_mode and options.run_file is None:
            if arg == "--":
                # This is the observed behavior of the bundled binary: -run -- leaves no input.
                options.run_args.extend(args[i + 1:])
                break
            options.run_file = arg
            i += 1
            continue

        if not stop_options and arg == "--":
            stop_options = True
            i += 1
            continue

        if not stop_options and arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            # Information / help options
            if arg in ("-h", "--help"):
                options.early_action = "help"
                return options, 0
            if arg == "-hh":
                options.early_action = "more_help"
                return options, 0
            if arg in ("-v", "--version", "-version"):
                options.verbose = max(options.verbose, 1)
                if arg in ("--version", "-version"):
                    options.early_action = "version"
                    return options, 0
                i += 1
                continue
            if arg == "-vv":
                options.verbose = max(options.verbose, 2)
                i += 1
                continue
            if arg == "-dumpversion":
                options.early_action = "dumpversion"
                return options, 0
            if arg == "-print-search-dirs":
                options.early_action = "search_dirs"
                return options, 0
            if arg == "-ar":
                options.ar_mode = True
                options.ar_args = []
                i += 1
                continue
            if arg == "-run":
                options.run_mode = True
                i += 1
                continue
            if arg == "-m32":
                return None, tcc_error("could not run './i386-tcc'")
            if arg == "-m64":
                # Native target.  TCC re-enters the native compiler; here it is a no-op.
                i += 1
                continue

            # Invalid exact options before general prefixes.
            if arg in INVALID_EXACT:
                return None, tcc_error(f"invalid option -- '{arg}'")
            if arg == "-help":
                return None, tcc_error("invalid option -- '-help'")

            # Options with exact spellings.
            if arg == "-c":
                options.compile_only = True
            elif arg == "-E":
                options.preprocess_only = True
            elif arg == "-r":
                options.relocatable = True
            elif arg == "-shared":
                options.shared = True
            elif arg == "-static":
                options.static = True
            elif arg == "-nostdinc":
                options.nostdinc = True
            elif arg == "-nostdlib":
                options.nostdlib = True
            elif arg == "-rdynamic":
                options.rdynamic = True
            elif arg == "-bench":
                options.bench = True
            elif arg == "-w":
                options.warnings_off = True
            elif arg == "-Wall":
                options.wall = True
                options.w_opts.append(arg)
            elif arg == "-Werror":
                options.warn_error = True
                options.w_opts.append(arg)
            elif arg.startswith("-Werror="):
                options.warn_error = True
                options.w_opts.append(arg)
            elif arg == "-pthread":
                options.pthread = True
                options.defines.append("_REENTRANT")
                options.pp_cmds.append(("D", "_REENTRANT"))
            elif arg in IGNORED_EXACT:
                pass
            elif arg == "-MD" or arg == "-MMD" or arg == "-M" or arg == "-MM":
                options.dep_kind = arg[1:]
                if arg in ("-M", "-MM"):
                    options.make_only = True
            elif arg == "-dM":
                options.dM = True
            elif arg == "-dD":
                options.dD = True
            elif arg == "-P":
                options.line_mode = 0
            elif re.fullmatch(r"-P[0-9]+", arg):
                val = int(arg[2:])
                options.line_mode = 1 if val == 1 else (0 if val == 0 else 2)
            elif arg.startswith("-std="):
                val = arg.split("=", 1)[1]
                # TCC accepts/ignores many versions but only c11/gnu11 affect predefined macros.
                if val in ("c11", "gnu11", "c99", "gnu99", "c89", "gnu89", "iso9899:2011"):
                    options.std = val
            elif arg.startswith("-O") and len(arg) >= 2:
                options.o_level = arg[2:] or "1"
                if options.o_level and options.o_level != "0":
                    options.defines.append("__OPTIMIZE__")
                    options.pp_cmds.append(("D", "__OPTIMIZE__"))
            elif arg == "-g" or arg.startswith("-g"):
                if arg.startswith("-gdwarf"):
                    options.dwarf = True
                else:
                    options.debug = True
            elif arg == "-b" or re.fullmatch(r"-bt[0-9]*", arg):
                options.bounds = True
                options.debug = True
            elif arg.startswith("-Wl,"):
                rc = parse_wl_option(arg[4:], options)
                if rc is not None:
                    return None, rc
            elif arg.startswith("-Wp,"):
                # Same as supplying the preprocessor options directly.
                extra, rc = expand_response_files(shlex.split(arg[4:].replace(",", " "), comments=False))
                if rc != 0:
                    return None, rc
                # Insert expanded items after current position.
                args = args[:i + 1] + (extra or []) + args[i + 1:]
            elif arg.startswith("-I"):
                if arg == "-I":
                    val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-I")
                    if rc is not None:
                        return None, rc
                    options.include_dirs.append(val or "")
                else:
                    options.include_dirs.append(arg[2:])
            elif arg.startswith("-D"):
                if arg == "-D":
                    val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-D")
                    if rc is not None:
                        return None, rc
                else:
                    val = arg[2:]
                if val == "":
                    return None, option_missing("-D")
                options.defines.append(val)
                options.pp_cmds.append(("D", val))
            elif arg.startswith("-U"):
                if arg == "-U":
                    val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-U")
                    if rc is not None:
                        return None, rc
                else:
                    val = arg[2:]
                if val == "":
                    return None, option_missing("-U")
                options.undefines.append(val)
                options.pp_cmds.append(("U", val))
            elif arg.startswith("-L"):
                if arg == "-L":
                    val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-L")
                    if rc is not None:
                        return None, rc
                    options.library_dirs.append(val or "")
                else:
                    options.library_dirs.append(arg[2:])
            elif arg.startswith("-l"):
                if arg == "-l":
                    val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-l")
                    if rc is not None:
                        return None, rc
                    options.libraries.append(val or "")
                else:
                    options.libraries.append(arg[2:])
            elif arg.startswith("-o"):
                if arg == "-o":
                    val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-o")
                    if rc is not None:
                        return None, rc
                    options.output = val
                else:
                    options.output = arg[2:]
            elif arg == "-MF":
                val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-MF")
                if rc is not None:
                    return None, rc
                options.dep_file = val
            elif arg == "-include":
                val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-include")
                if rc is not None:
                    return None, rc
                options.forced_includes.append(val or "")
            elif arg == "-isystem":
                val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-isystem")
                if rc is not None:
                    return None, rc
                options.system_include_dirs.append(val or "")
            elif arg.startswith("-B"):
                if arg == "-B":
                    val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-B")
                    if rc is not None:
                        return None, rc
                else:
                    val = arg[2:]
                # TCC's -B changes private dir; for compatibility add plausible include/lib dirs.
                if val:
                    options.include_dirs.append(os.path.join(val, "include"))
                    options.library_dirs.insert(0, val)
            elif arg == "-rstdin":
                val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-rstdin")
                if rc is not None:
                    return None, rc
                options.rstdin = val
            elif arg == "-x":
                val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-x")
                if rc is not None:
                    return None, rc
                if val in LANG_MAP:
                    options.current_lang = LANG_MAP[val]
                else:
                    eprint(f"tcc: warning: unsupported language '{val}'")
                    options.current_lang = None
            elif re.fullmatch(r"-x[abcn]", arg):
                options.current_lang = LANG_MAP[arg[2:]]
            elif arg.startswith("-x"):
                val = arg[2:]
                eprint(f"tcc: warning: unsupported language '{val}'")
                options.current_lang = None
            elif arg == "-soname":
                val, i, rc = take_arg(args, i, "-soname")
                if rc is not None:
                    return None, rc
                options.soname = val
            elif arg.startswith("-f"):
                # TCC accepts many -f flags and silently ignores unknown ones.
                options.f_opts.append(arg)
            elif arg.startswith("-W"):
                # TCC accepts many -W flags and silently ignores unknown ones.
                options.w_opts.append(arg)
            elif arg.startswith("--param"):
                if arg == "--param" and i + 1 < len(args):
                    i += 1
            elif arg == "-arch":
                if i + 1 < len(args):
                    i += 1
            else:
                return None, tcc_error(f"invalid option -- '{arg}'")
        else:
            options.inputs.append(InputFile(arg, options.current_lang))
        i += 1

    return options, 0


def source_display_name(options: Options) -> str:
    if options.preprocess_only or options.make_only:
        if options.inputs:
            return options.inputs[0].name
        if options.run_file:
            return options.run_file
    if options.inputs:
        return options.inputs[0].name
    if options.run_file:
        return options.run_file
    return "-"


def object_name_for_input(inp: str) -> str:
    if inp == "-":
        return "a.out"
    base = os.path.basename(inp)
    root, _ = os.path.splitext(base)
    return (root or "a") + ".o"


def default_dep_file(options: Options) -> str:
    if options.dep_file:
        return options.dep_file
    target = options.output if options.output and (options.compile_only or options.relocatable) else object_name_for_input(source_display_name(options))
    root, _ = os.path.splitext(target)
    return root + ".d"


def dependency_target(options: Options) -> str:
    if options.output and options.compile_only and len(options.inputs) == 1:
        return options.output
    return object_name_for_input(source_display_name(options))


def find_include_file(header: str, from_file: str, options: Options, system: bool) -> Optional[str]:
    dirs: List[str] = []
    if not system and from_file != "-":
        dirs.append(os.path.dirname(from_file) or ".")
    dirs.extend(options.include_dirs)
    dirs.extend(options.system_include_dirs)
    if not options.nostdinc:
        dirs.extend(TCC_STD_INC_DIRS)
    for d in dirs:
        p = os.path.join(d, header)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return os.path.normpath(p)
    return None


def collect_deps_for_file(path: str, options: Options, seen: Optional[set] = None) -> List[str]:
    if seen is None:
        seen = set()
    deps: List[str] = []
    if path in seen or path == "-":
        return deps
    seen.add(path)
    try:
        text = Path(path).read_text(errors="ignore")
    except OSError:
        return deps
    inc_re = re.compile(r'^\s*#\s*include\s*(["<])([^">]+)[">]')
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = inc_re.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        quoted = m.group(1) == '"'
        if options.dep_kind in ("MM", "MMD") and not quoted:
            continue
        found = find_include_file(m.group(2), path, options, not quoted)
        if found:
            shown = os.path.relpath(found) if not os.path.isabs(m.group(2)) and found.startswith(os.getcwd()) else found
            if shown.startswith("./"):
                shown = shown[2:]
            deps.append(shown)
            deps.extend(collect_deps_for_file(found, options, seen))
    return deps


def make_dependency_text(options: Options) -> str:
    target = dependency_target(options)
    main = source_display_name(options)
    deps = [main] + collect_deps_for_file(main, options)
    # Preserve order while removing duplicates.
    unique: List[str] = []
    for d in deps:
        if d not in unique:
            unique.append(d)
    lines = [f"{target}: \\"]
    for idx, dep in enumerate(unique):
        suffix = " \\" if idx < len(unique) - 1 else ""
        lines.append(f"  {dep}{suffix}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def maybe_write_deps(options: Options) -> None:
    if not options.dep_kind:
        return
    text = make_dependency_text(options)
    if options.make_only:
        if options.dep_file:
            Path(options.dep_file).write_text(text)
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(text)
    else:
        Path(default_dep_file(options)).write_text(text)


def scan_defines_from_text(text: str) -> List[str]:
    out: List[str] = []
    # This deliberately simple scanner mirrors common -dM use; complex conditionals are handled
    # by the host preprocessor in non--dM mode.
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'\s*#\s*(define|undef)\s+(.+?)\s*$', line)
        if not m:
            continue
        kind, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if kind == "define":
            # Preserve the user's spelling after #define.
            out.append("#define " + rest)
        else:
            out.append("#undef " + rest.split()[0])
    return out


def read_source_text_for_dm(options: Options) -> str:
    if not options.inputs:
        return ""
    name = options.inputs[0].name
    if name == "-":
        return sys.stdin.read()
    try:
        return Path(name).read_text(errors="ignore")
    except FileNotFoundError:
        raise


def handle_dM(options: Options) -> int:
    if not options.inputs:
        return tcc_error("no input files")
    inp = options.inputs[0].name
    if inp != "-" and not os.path.exists(inp):
        return tcc_error(f"file '{inp}' not found")
    try:
        source_text = read_source_text_for_dm(options)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return tcc_error(f"file '{inp}' not found")
    base = inp
    lines = builtin_macro_lines(options.std, base)
    for kind, val in options.pp_cmds:
        if kind == "D":
            lines.append(define_to_line(val))
        else:
            lines.append("#undef " + val)
    lines.extend(scan_defines_from_text(source_text))
    out = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    if options.output and options.output != "-":
        Path(options.output).write_text(out)
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(out)
    return 0


def gcc_predefine_args(options: Options, base_file: str) -> List[str]:
    args: List[str] = ["-undef"]
    for spec in BUILTIN_DEFINES_FOR_GCC:
        args.append("-D" + spec)
    args.append(f"-D__STDC_VERSION__={std_version_value(options.std)}")
    if std_version_value(options.std) == "201112L":
        args.extend(["-D__STDC_NO_ATOMICS__=1", "-D__STDC_NO_COMPLEX__=1", "-D__STDC_NO_THREADS__=1",
                     "-D__STDC_UTF_16__=1", "-D__STDC_UTF_32__=1"])
    args.append(f"-D__BASE_FILE__=\"{base_file}\"")
    for spec in options.defines:
        args.append(define_arg_for_gcc(spec))
    for name in options.undefines:
        args.append("-U" + name)
    return args


def cpp_include_args(options: Options) -> List[str]:
    args: List[str] = []
    args.append("-nostdinc")
    for d in options.include_dirs:
        args.extend(["-I", d])
    for d in options.system_include_dirs:
        args.extend(["-isystem", d])
    if not options.nostdinc:
        for d in TCC_STD_INC_DIRS:
            args.extend(["-I", d])
    for inc in options.forced_includes:
        args.extend(["-include", inc])
    return args


def transform_stderr_common(stderr: str) -> str:
    stderr = normalize_quotes(stderr)
    out_lines: List[str] = []
    for line in stderr.splitlines():
        if not line or line == "compilation terminated.":
            continue
        # Skip GCC context lines/caret notes for a TCC-like compact diagnostic.
        if re.match(r"\s*(\^|~+|\|)", line):
            continue
        if re.match(r"\s*\d+\s*\|", line):
            continue
        if line.endswith(": In function 'main':") or re.search(r": In function '.+':$", line):
            continue
        m = re.match(r"(.+):(\d+):(\d+): fatal error: ([^:]+): No such file or directory", line)
        if m:
            out_lines.append(f"{m.group(1)}:{m.group(2)}: error: include file '{m.group(4)}' not found")
            continue
        m = re.match(r"(.+):(\d+):(\d+): (warning|error): (.*)", line)
        if m:
            file, lno, kind, msg = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(4), m.group(5)
            msg = re.sub(r" \[-W[^\]]+\]", "", msg)
            msg = re.sub(r" \(first use in this function\)", "", msg)
            msg = re.sub(r", in function returning non-void", "", msg)
            if "implicit declaration of function" in msg:
                mm = re.search(r"implicit declaration of function '([^']+)'", msg)
                if mm:
                    msg = f"implicit declaration of function '{mm.group(1)}'"
            if "'return' with no value" in msg:
                msg = "'return' with no value"
            out_lines.append(f"{file}:{lno}: {kind}: {msg}")
            continue
        # GNU ld missing lib -> TCC style.
        m = re.search(r"cannot find -l([^: ]+)", line)
        if m:
            out_lines.append(f"tcc: error: library '{m.group(1)}' not found")
            continue
        # Undefined reference simplification.
        m = re.search(r"undefined reference to `?([^'`]+)'?", line)
        if m:
            out_lines.append(f"tcc: error: undefined symbol '{m.group(1)}'")
            continue
        if "cannot find entry symbol _start" in line:
            out_lines.append("tcc: error: _start not defined")
            continue
        out_lines.append(line)
    # Remove duplicates while preserving order (ld often repeats undefined symbols).
    dedup: List[str] = []
    for l in out_lines:
        if l not in dedup:
            dedup.append(l)
    return ("\n".join(dedup) + ("\n" if dedup else ""))


def postprocess_cpp_output(text: str, display: str, line_mode: int) -> str:
    # If -P was requested, cpp already omitted markers.
    if line_mode == 0:
        return text
    lines = text.splitlines()
    rest: List[str] = []
    skipped_main_marker = False
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("# 0 "):
            continue
        if not skipped_main_marker and (line == f'# 1 "{display}"' or line == '# 1 "<stdin>"'):
            skipped_main_marker = True
            continue
        rest.append(line.replace('"<stdin>"', '"-"'))
    if line_mode == 1:
        header = [f'#line 1 "{display}"', '#line 1 "<command line>"', f'#line 1 "{display}"']
        converted: List[str] = []
        for line in rest:
            m = re.match(r'# (\d+) "([^"]+)"(?: .*)?', line)
            if m:
                converted.append(f'#line {m.group(1)} "{m.group(2)}"')
            else:
                converted.append(line)
        return "\n".join(header + converted) + ("\n" if text.endswith("\n") or converted else "")
    header = [f'# 1 "{display}"', '# 1 "<command line>" 1', f'# 1 "{display}" 2']
    return "\n".join(header + rest) + ("\n" if text.endswith("\n") or rest else "")


def run_cpp(options: Options) -> int:
    if not options.inputs:
        return tcc_error("no input files")
    if options.dM:
        return handle_dM(options)

    cpp = shutil.which("cpp") or shutil.which("gcc")
    if not cpp:
        return tcc_error("could not run 'cpp'")
    inp = options.inputs[0].name
    if inp != "-" and not os.path.exists(inp):
        return tcc_error(f"file '{inp}' not found")
    display = inp

    cmd = [cpp]
    if os.path.basename(cpp).startswith("gcc"):
        cmd.append("-E")
    else:
        cmd.append("-E")
    if options.line_mode == 0:
        cmd.append("-P")
    if options.dD:
        cmd.append("-dD")
    cmd += gcc_predefine_args(options, display)
    cmd += cpp_include_args(options)
    if options.std in ("c11", "gnu11", "c99", "gnu99", "c89", "gnu89"):
        # cpp accepts GNU/C std spellings through -std=.
        cmd.append("-std=" + options.std)
    if inp == "-":
        cmd.append("-")
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    else:
        cmd.append(inp)
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

    out_text = proc.stdout.decode(errors="replace")
    err_text = transform_stderr_common(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
    out_text = postprocess_cpp_output(out_text, display, options.line_mode)

    if options.verbose:
        print_version()
        print(f"-> {display}")
    if options.output and options.output != "-":
        Path(options.output).write_text(out_text)
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(out_text)
    if err_text:
        sys.stderr.write(err_text)
    if options.bench and proc.returncode == 0:
        write_bench_stub(options, preprocessed=True)
    return proc.returncode


def write_bench_stub(options: Options, preprocessed: bool = False) -> None:
    # The real compiler reports exact tokenizer/code sizes.  This stable approximation keeps the
    # observable footer shape without pretending to know internal counters.
    lines = 0
    bytes_ = 0
    for inp in options.inputs[:1]:
        if inp.name != "-" and os.path.exists(inp.name):
            data = Path(inp.name).read_bytes()
            bytes_ += len(data)
            lines += data.count(b"\n") or 1
    ident = 1130 + lines * 10
    text = 0 if preprocessed else 18
    sys.stderr.write(f"# {ident} idents, {lines} lines, {bytes_} bytes\n")
    sys.stderr.write("# 0.001 s, 3000 lines/s, 0.0 MB/s\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"# text {text}, data.rw 0, data.ro 0, bss 0 bytes\n")


def language_for_input(inp: InputFile) -> Optional[str]:
    if inp.lang:
        return inp.lang
    if inp.name == "-":
        return "c"
    ext = os.path.splitext(inp.name)[1].lower()
    if ext in (".s", ".asm"):
        return "assembler"
    if ext in (".S",):
        return "assembler-with-cpp"
    if ext in (".o", ".obj", ".a", ".so"):
        return None
    return "c"


def gcc_common_args(options: Options, for_compile: bool = False) -> List[str]:
    args: List[str] = ["-fno-diagnostics-color"]
    # GCC 11 supports this; if an older GCC does not, it will fail visibly.  The benchmark host has it.
    args.append("-fdiagnostics-plain-output")
    if options.warnings_off:
        args.append("-w")
    else:
        args.append("-Wimplicit-function-declaration")
        if options.wall:
            args.append("-Wall")
    if options.warn_error:
        args.append("-Werror")
    if options.std in ("c11", "gnu11", "c99", "gnu99", "c89", "gnu89"):
        args.append("-std=" + options.std)
    else:
        args.append("-std=gnu99")
    if options.o_level is not None:
        args.append("-O" + options.o_level)
    if options.debug or options.dwarf:
        args.append("-g")
    # TCC defaults to common symbols.
    args.append("-fcommon")
    # Define the main TCC-specific macros for compiled programs.  Do not use -undef here so system
    # headers supplied by GCC remain usable for functional compilation.
    args.append("-D__TINYC__=928")
    args.append("-D__TCC__=1")
    if std_version_value(options.std) == "201112L":
        args.append("-D__STDC_VERSION__=201112L")
    for spec in options.defines:
        args.append("-D" + spec)
    for name in options.undefines:
        args.append("-U" + name)
    for d in options.include_dirs:
        args.extend(["-I", d])
    for d in options.system_include_dirs:
        args.extend(["-isystem", d])
    for inc in options.forced_includes:
        args.extend(["-include", inc])
    if options.nostdinc:
        args.append("-nostdinc")
    if options.pthread:
        args.append("-pthread")
    return args


def run_subprocess_and_relay(cmd: List[str], *, stdout_to: Optional[str] = None) -> int:
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if stdout_to:
        with open(stdout_to, "wb") as f:
            f.write(proc.stdout)
    else:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(proc.stdout)
    sys.stderr.write(transform_stderr_common(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace")))
    return proc.returncode


def check_input_files(options: Options) -> Optional[int]:
    for inp in options.inputs:
        if inp.name != "-" and not os.path.exists(inp.name):
            return tcc_error(f"file '{inp.name}' not found")
    return None


def compile_objects(options: Options) -> int:
    gcc = shutil.which("gcc") or shutil.which("cc")
    if not gcc:
        return tcc_error("could not run 'gcc'")
    rc = check_input_files(options)
    if rc is not None:
        return rc
    if len(options.inputs) > 1 and options.output:
        return tcc_error("cannot specify output file with -c many files")
    if not options.inputs:
        return tcc_error("no input files")

    if options.verbose:
        print_version()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tcccompat-") as td:
        final_rc = 0
        for inp in options.inputs:
            lang = language_for_input(inp)
            src = inp.name
            try:
                if lang == "c" and (inp.name == "-" or (inp.name != "-" and Path(inp.name).read_bytes().startswith(b"#!"))):
                    src = remove_shebang_to_temp(inp.name, td)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                return tcc_error(f"file '{inp.name}' not found")
            out = options.output if options.output else object_name_for_input(inp.name)
            cmd = [gcc, "-c"] + gcc_common_args(options, for_compile=True)
            if lang:
                cmd += ["-x", lang]
            cmd += [src, "-o", out]
            if options.verbose:
                print(f"-> {inp.name}")
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(proc.stdout)
            sys.stderr.write(transform_stderr_common(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace")))
            if proc.returncode != 0:
                final_rc = proc.returncode
                break
            if options.verbose:
                print(f"<- {out}")
        if final_rc == 0:
            maybe_write_deps(options)
            if options.bench:
                write_bench_stub(options)
        return final_rc


def library_exists(name: str, dirs: List[str]) -> bool:
    if name.startswith(":"):
        target = name[1:]
        for d in dirs:
            if os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, target)):
                return True
        return False
    for d in dirs:
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, f"lib{name}.so")) or os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, f"lib{name}.a")):
            return True
    return False


def link_or_relocate(options: Options) -> int:
    gcc = shutil.which("gcc") or shutil.which("cc")
    if not gcc:
        return tcc_error("could not run 'gcc'")
    rc = check_input_files(options)
    if rc is not None:
        return rc
    if not options.inputs:
        return tcc_error("no input files")

    # TCC reports missing -l libraries before most compilation diagnostics.  Pre-check obvious misses
    # while still allowing the system linker to handle unusual cases.
    lib_dirs = options.library_dirs + TCC_LIB_DIRS
    for lib in options.libraries:
        if lib and not library_exists(lib, lib_dirs):
            return tcc_error(f"library '{lib}' not found")

    if options.verbose:
        print_version()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tcccompat-") as td:
        cmd = [gcc]
        cmd += gcc_common_args(options)
        if options.relocatable:
            cmd.append("-r")
        if options.shared:
            cmd.append("-shared")
        if options.static:
            cmd.append("-static")
        if options.nostdlib:
            cmd.append("-nostdlib")
        if options.rdynamic:
            cmd.append("-rdynamic")
        for d in options.library_dirs:
            cmd.extend(["-L", d])
        if options.soname:
            cmd.append("-Wl,-soname," + options.soname)
        cmd += options.linker_opts

        # Prepare sources.  GCC can compile and link in one step, but stdin/shebang need temp files.
        for inp in options.inputs:
            lang = language_for_input(inp)
            src = inp.name
            try:
                if lang == "c" and (inp.name == "-" or (inp.name != "-" and Path(inp.name).read_bytes().startswith(b"#!"))):
                    src = remove_shebang_to_temp(inp.name, td)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                return tcc_error(f"file '{inp.name}' not found")
            if lang and src != inp.name:
                cmd += ["-x", lang, src, "-x", "none"]
            elif lang and inp.name == "-":
                cmd += ["-x", lang, src, "-x", "none"]
            else:
                if lang in ("assembler", "assembler-with-cpp") and inp.lang:
                    cmd += ["-x", lang, src, "-x", "none"]
                else:
                    cmd.append(src)
            if options.verbose:
                print(f"-> {inp.name}")
        for lib in options.libraries:
            cmd.append("-l" + lib)
        out = options.output or "a.out"
        cmd += ["-o", out]
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(proc.stdout)
        sys.stderr.write(transform_stderr_common(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace")))
        if proc.returncode == 0:
            maybe_write_deps(options)
            if options.verbose:
                print(f"<- {out}")
            if options.bench:
                write_bench_stub(options)
        return proc.returncode


def run_mode(options: Options) -> int:
    if not options.run_file:
        return tcc_error("no input files")
    if options.run_file != "-" and not os.path.exists(options.run_file):
        return tcc_error(f"file '{options.run_file}' not found")
    gcc = shutil.which("gcc") or shutil.which("cc")
    if not gcc:
        return tcc_error("could not run 'gcc'")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tccrun-") as td:
        exe = os.path.join(td, "a.out")
        run_input = InputFile(options.run_file, "c")
        src = options.run_file
        try:
            if src == "-" or (src != "-" and Path(src).read_bytes().startswith(b"#!")):
                src = remove_shebang_to_temp(src, td)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return tcc_error(f"file '{options.run_file}' not found")
        cmd = [gcc] + gcc_common_args(options) + ["-x", "c", src, "-x", "none", "-o", exe]
        for d in options.library_dirs:
            cmd.extend(["-L", d])
        for lib in options.libraries:
            cmd.append("-l" + lib)
        if options.pthread:
            cmd.append("-pthread")
        if options.verbose:
            print_version()
            print(f"-> {options.run_file}")
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(proc.stdout)
        sys.stderr.write(transform_stderr_common(proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace")))
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            return proc.returncode
        stdin_obj = None
        try:
            if options.rstdin:
                stdin_obj = open(options.rstdin, "rb")
            # Popen(executable=exe) lets argv[0] match the source file, as TCC's -run does.
            child = subprocess.Popen([options.run_file] + options.run_args, executable=exe, stdin=stdin_obj)
            child.wait()
            return child.returncode
        finally:
            if stdin_obj:
                stdin_obj.close()


def ar_mode(options: Options) -> int:
    if len(options.ar_args) < 2:
        sys.stderr.write("usage: tcc -ar [crstvx] lib [files]\ncreate library ([abdiopN] not supported).\n")
        return 1
    ar = shutil.which("ar")
    if not ar:
        return tcc_error("could not run 'ar'")
    flags = options.ar_args[0]
    # TCC's ar frontend rejects uncommon operations listed in the usage line.
    if any(ch in flags for ch in "abdiopN"):
        sys.stderr.write("usage: tcc -ar [crstvx] lib [files]\ncreate library ([abdiopN] not supported).\n")
        return 1
    cmd = [ar] + options.ar_args
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(proc.stdout)
    # GNU ar messages are acceptable here; TCC itself delegates archive format work.
    sys.stderr.buffer.write(proc.stderr)
    return proc.returncode


def dispatch(options: Options) -> int:
    if options.early_action == "help" or options.show_help_due_noargs:
        sys.stdout.write(HELP_TEXT)
        return 0
    if options.early_action == "more_help":
        sys.stdout.write(MORE_HELP_TEXT)
        return 0
    if options.early_action == "version":
        print_version()
        return 0
    if options.early_action == "dumpversion":
        print(VERSION_SHORT)
        return 0
    if options.early_action == "search_dirs":
        print_search_dirs()
        return 0
    if options.ar_mode:
        return ar_mode(options)

    if options.verbose and not options.inputs and not options.run_mode:
        print_version()
        if options.verbose >= 2:
            print_search_dirs()
        return 0

    if options.run_mode:
        return run_mode(options)

    if not options.inputs:
        return tcc_error("no input files")

    if options.make_only:
        # TCC -M/-MM produces dependencies and no other output.
        rc = check_input_files(options)
        if rc is not None:
            return rc
        maybe_write_deps(options)
        return 0

    if options.preprocess_only:
        return run_cpp(options)

    if options.compile_only:
        return compile_objects(options)

    return link_or_relocate(options)


def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    expanded, rc = expand_response_files(argv)
    if rc != 0:
        return rc
    assert expanded is not None
    options, rc = parse_args(expanded)
    if rc != 0:
        return rc
    if options is None:
        return rc
    return dispatch(options)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except BrokenPipeError:
        raise SystemExit(1)
